{{Top}}
{{Youmay|the [[in-universe]] position|the [[Wookieepedia:Administrators#Becoming a bureaucrat|bureaucrats]] of [[Wookieepedia]]}}
{{Quote|Enter the bureaucrats. The true rulers of the Republic.|[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
A '''bureaucrat''' was a person who held an administrative position in an organization. [[Shodon Ko]] was a bureaucrat for the [[Hyperspace Navigator's Guild]].

[[File:ZodKneelsBeforeAmidala-TPMHD.jpg|thumb|right|320px|Palpatine derided Chancellor Valorum (center) as a weak politician dominated by bureaucrats, convincing Queen Amidala to initiate a vote to oust him.]]
When [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] tried to persuade [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of the sovereign [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] that the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]], had a [[Politics/Legends|politically]] weak position in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]], Palpatine told Amidala that the intervention of [[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice Chancellor]] [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] and [[Senior Administrative Aide/Legends|Staff Aide]] [[Sei Taria/Legends|Sei Taria]] in Valorum's speech to be an indication of a Republic mired by the interests of bureaucrats.<ref name="TPM" />

After a brief exchange between Valorum and his staff, the Chancellor agreed with the delegates of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]&mdash;which had [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] Naboo to protest trade regulations&mdash;that a Senate committee be established to ascertain the situation on the planet. Frustrated by the Senate's bureaucracy and inaction, Queen Amidala tabled a [[Vote of No Confidence/Legends|Vote of No Confidence]] in Chancellor Valorum's leadership. Palpatine was subsequently [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY/Legends|elected]] as the Republic's Supreme Chancellor due to the Senate's sympathy for Naboo<ref name="TPM" /> and held on to his [[Emergency Powers Act/Legends|emergency powers]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], asserting absolute power at the end of the war as the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|New Galactic Empire]];<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> the final remnant of the Republic and [[Democracy/Legends|democracy]] was abolished with the dissolution of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] just before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>
